demos.text: How many distinct parts (purchased components) does product BK-R50R-48 contain at any level of its current BOM?

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(component_id) AS (
    SELECT b.component_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R50R-48'
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION
    
    SELECT b.component_id
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bt.component_id)
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id
WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE;
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R50R-48'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * bt.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    INNER JOIN bom_tree bt ON c.parent_code = bt.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bt.child_code) AS distinct_parts
FROM bom_tree bt
INNER JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bt.child_code
WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE;
queries.cypher:
MATCH (root:Product {product_number: 'BK-R50R-48'})
      -[e:HAS_SUBASSEMBLY|HAS_PART*1..20 (r, n | WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2025-06-30') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= date('2025-06-30')))]->
      (part:Product)
WHERE part.make_flag = false
RETURN count(DISTINCT part.product_id) AS distinct_parts;
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (p:Product {product_number: 'BK-R50R-48'})-[e:CONTAINS*1..10]->(part:Product)
WHERE part.make_flag = false
  AND all(r IN rels(e) WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2025-06-30') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2025-06-30') <= r.valid_to))
RETURN count(DISTINCT part.product_id) AS distinct_parts;

demos.text: How many bikes contain component EC-M092 at any level of their current BOM (directly or inside sub-assemblies)?

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (
    SELECT p.product_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory sc ON p.subcategory_id = sc.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category c ON sc.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE c.name = 'Bikes'
),
bom_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target component and walk upward to assemblies
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    WHERE bom.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'EC-M092')
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON bom.component_id = bt.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bt.assembly_id) AS bike_count
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN bike_products bp ON bt.assembly_id = bp.product_id;
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_code,
        child_code
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        bt.parent_code,
        c.child_code
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN u_composition c 
      ON bt.child_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)
FROM product p
JOIN product_subcategory sc ON p.subcategory_id = sc.subcategory_id
JOIN product_category cat ON sc.category_id = cat.category_id
WHERE cat.name = 'Bikes'
  AND p.product_number IN (
      SELECT parent_code
      FROM bom_tree
      WHERE child_code = 'EC-M092'
  );
queries.cypher:
MATCH (bike:Product)-[:IN_SUBCATEGORY]->(:Subcategory)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(:Category {name: 'Bikes'})
MATCH (bike)-[e:HAS_SUBASSEMBLY|HAS_PART*1..10]->(comp:Product {product_number: 'EC-M092'})
WHERE all(r IN rels(e) WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2025-06-30') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= date('2025-06-30')))
RETURN count(DISTINCT bike) AS bike_count;
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (bike:Product)-[:IN_SUBCATEGORY]->(:Subcategory)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(:Category {name: 'Bikes'})
MATCH (bike)-[e:CONTAINS*1..10]->(comp:Product {product_number: 'EC-M092'})
WHERE all(r IN rels(e) WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2025-06-30') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2025-06-30') <= r.valid_to))
RETURN count(DISTINCT bike) AS bike_count;

demos.text: In the current BOM, how many units of component BB-8107 does product BK-T44U-46 use directly per unit (first level only)?

queries.sql:
SELECT b.per_assembly_qty
FROM bill_of_materials b
JOIN product assembly ON b.assembly_id = assembly.product_id
JOIN product component ON b.component_id = component.product_id
WHERE assembly.product_number = 'BK-T44U-46'
  AND component.product_number = 'BB-8107'
  AND b.bom_level = 1
  AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30');
queries.sql_u:
SELECT qty
FROM u_composition
WHERE parent_code = 'BK-T44U-46'
  AND child_code = 'BB-8107'
  AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30');
queries.cypher:
MATCH (p:Product {product_number: 'BK-T44U-46'})-[bom:HAS_SUBASSEMBLY|HAS_PART]->(c:Product {product_number: 'BB-8107'})
WHERE bom.valid_from <= date('2025-06-30')
  AND (bom.valid_to IS NULL OR bom.valid_to >= date('2025-06-30'))
RETURN bom.qty AS units;
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (p:Product {product_number: 'BK-T44U-46'})-[c:CONTAINS]->(comp:Product {product_number: 'BB-8107'})
WHERE c.valid_from <= date('2025-06-30')
  AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2025-06-30') <= c.valid_to)
RETURN c.qty AS units;

demos.text: By how much did the total quantity of part TI-R628 per unit of product BK-R79Y-48 (all levels) change from the BOM valid on 2021-11-30 to the current BOM? Return current minus earlier.

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN product p ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R79Y-48'
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-11-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-11-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty * bt.per_assembly_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN bom_tree_2021 bt ON b.assembly_id = bt.component_id
    JOIN product p ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-11-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-11-30')
),
bom_tree_current AS (
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN product p ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R79Y-48'
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty * bt.per_assembly_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN bom_tree_current bt ON b.assembly_id = bt.component_id
    JOIN product p ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
qty_2021 AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.per_assembly_qty), 0) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree_2021 bt
    JOIN product p ON bt.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'TI-R628'
),
qty_current AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.per_assembly_qty), 0) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree_current bt
    JOIN product p ON bt.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'TI-R628'
)
SELECT qc.total_qty - q2021.total_qty AS change_in_qty
FROM qty_current qc, qty_2021 q2021;
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE bom_2021 AS (
    SELECT
        child_code,
        qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_code = 'BK-R79Y-48'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2021-11-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2021-11-30')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * b.qty_per_unit AS qty_per_unit
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_2021 b ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2021-11-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2021-11-30')
),
bom_current AS (
    SELECT
        child_code,
        qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_code = 'BK-R79Y-48'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * b.qty_per_unit AS qty_per_unit
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_current b ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(curr.total_qty, 0) - COALESCE(prev.total_qty, 0) AS change_in_qty
FROM
    (SELECT SUM(qty_per_unit) AS total_qty FROM bom_2021 WHERE child_code = 'TI-R628') prev,
    (SELECT SUM(qty_per_unit) AS total_qty FROM bom_current WHERE child_code = 'TI-R628') curr;
queries.cypher:
WITH date('2021-11-30') AS old_date, date('2025-06-30') AS new_date
MATCH (root:Product {product_number: 'BK-R79Y-48'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[e_old:HAS_SUBASSEMBLY|HAS_PART*1..6]->(p_old:Product {product_number: 'TI-R628'})
WHERE all(r IN rels(e_old) WHERE r.valid_from <= old_date AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR old_date <= r.valid_to))
WITH old_date, new_date, root, sum(list_product(properties(rels(e_old), 'qty'))) AS old_qty
OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[e_new:HAS_SUBASSEMBLY|HAS_PART*1..6]->(p_new:Product {product_number: 'TI-R628'})
WHERE all(r IN rels(e_new) WHERE r.valid_from <= new_date AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR new_date <= r.valid_to))
WITH old_qty, sum(list_product(properties(rels(e_new), 'qty'))) AS new_qty
RETURN new_qty - old_qty AS change
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (p:Product {product_number: 'BK-R79Y-48'})
MATCH (part:Product {product_number: 'TI-R628'})
MATCH path = (p)-[e:CONTAINS*0..6 (r, n | WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2021-11-30') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2021-11-30') <= r.valid_to))]->(part)
WITH 1 AS dummy, sum(list_product(properties(rels(e), 'qty'))) AS earlier
MATCH (p2:Product {product_number: 'BK-R79Y-48'})
MATCH (part2:Product {product_number: 'TI-R628'})
MATCH path2 = (p2)-[e2:CONTAINS*0..6 (r2, n2 | WHERE r2.valid_from <= date('2025-06-30') AND (r2.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2025-06-30') <= r2.valid_to))]->(part2)
WITH earlier, sum(list_product(properties(rels(e2), 'qty'))) AS current
RETURN current - earlier AS change
